item.title: Week Ahead: US Dollar slips on trade uncertainty as NFP, Eurozone HICP loom
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) lost ground this week amid geopolitical uncertainty and the United States (US) trade policy developments after the Supreme Court ruled the Trump administration's tariffs illegal and he responded with a fresh round of levies.

item.title: Gold hits $5,260 as war jitters, trade tension rattle markets
item.description: A red-hot inflation report in the United States and rising tensions between the latter and Iran pushed Gold price higher on Friday, past the $5,260 figure, posting solid gains of over 1.20%.

item.title: Breaking: US and Israel attack Iran, risk aversion to sweep global markets
item.description: Early Saturday, United States (US) President Donald Trump announced that the US had begun “major combat operations” in Iran, following Israel’s pre-emptive missile attacks against Tehran.
